newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ROBSON READY FOR MIDDLESBROUGH COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON READY FOR MIDDLESBROUGH COMEBACK.

text.p: Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson could be forced to return to premier league action on New Year's Day because of an injury crisis at the club.

Seven players have been ruled out of the visit to Arsenal and with three others doubtful, Robson may have to play -- 10 days short of his 40th birthday and nearly a year since his last first team appearance.
"I have included myself in the squad and I might play," said the former England midfielder on Monday. "I will have to check up on the fitness of other players before we leave for London."
Middlesbrough face a league inquiry after calling off a match against Blackburn on December 21. They claimed more than 20 players were injured or ill.
